data.long_meaning: Aniweta is derived from the Greek word ana, meaning 'up' or 'grace,' and the Latin word vita, meaning 'life' or 'gift.' This name signifies a graceful gift from God. The name Aniweta carries the meaning “Graceful Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aniweta usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
